title: Divalent and Mixed-Valence Samarium Clusters Supported by Dipyrrolide Ligand

material_class.structural_family: pentanuclear Sm(II) dipyrrolide cluster with a central μ5-iodide and a discrete [K(THF)6]+ cation

synthesis.procedure: Under N2 using Schlenk/drybox techniques, solid KH (0.2 g, 5.0 mmol) was added to methylphenyl dipyrromethane (0.6 g, 2.5 mmol) in THF (75 mL), giving immediate effervescence. The suspension was stirred at room temperature for 20 min until a microcrystalline solid accumulated and gas evolution stopped. SmI2(THF)2 (1.3 g, 2.4 mmol) was added, causing an immediate color change to dark purple-brown. After stirring at room temperature under N2 for 24 h and filtration to remove KI, the solution was concentrated to about 25 mL. Toluene (25 mL) was added and the mixture stood at room temperature for 2 weeks, precipitating dark brown crystals of 1 (0.5 g, 0.2 mmol, 42%).
synthesis.time: 20 min deprotonation; 24 h after SmI2 addition; 2 weeks crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration to remove KI; concentration to ~25 mL; addition of toluene (25 mL); standing at room temperature for 2 weeks gave dark brown crystals.

properties.summary: Paramagnetic pentanuclear Sm(II) cluster; room-temperature Gouy-balance effective magnetic moment μ_eff = 5.15 μB after diamagnetic correction.

measurements.name: μ_eff
measurements.conditions: room temperature, Gouy balance, diamagnetic correction applied

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion; Experimental Section, Preparation of 1

material_class.structural_family: planar mixed-valent Sm(II)/Sm(III) tetramer with a linear central μ-oxo and bridging cyclohexyl dipyrrolide ligands

synthesis.procedure: Method A: NaH (0.8 g, 33.3 mmol) was added to cyclohexyl dipyrromethane (3.7 g, 17.3 mmol) in THF (150 mL) and stirred 1 h at room temperature, forming a microcrystalline solid. Subsequent treatment with SmCl3(THF)n (7.6 g, 16.1 mmol) gave a yellow suspension that was stirred 1 h at room temperature, thoroughly degassed, and treated with metallic sodium (0.37 g, 16.2 mmol) under Ar plus catalytic naphthalene (0.06 g, 0.5 mmol). Stirring 16 h at room temperature produced a deep purple-red solution, which was filtered, concentrated to 50 mL, layered with hexanes (50 mL), and stood at room temperature for 4 days to give crystals of 2 (1.8 g, 1.0 mmol, 26%). Method B: cyclohexyl dipyrromethane (3.9 g, 18.2 mmol) in THF (100 mL) under Ar was treated with KH (1.5 g, 37.0 mmol), stirred 30 min at room temperature, then treated with SmI2(THF)2 (9.4 g, 17.2 mmol). After 16 h at room temperature, filtration, concentration to 50 mL, layering with hexanes (25 mL), and standing 2 days at room temperature yielded purple-red crystals of 2 (1.5 g, 0.8 mmol, 20%).

reagents.name: cyclohexyl dipyrromethane
reagents.amount: 3.7 g, 17.3 mmol (Method A); 3.9 g, 18.2 mmol (Method B)

synthesis.time: Method A: 1 h deprotonation, 1 h after SmCl3, 16 h reduction, 4 days crystallization; Method B: 30 min deprotonation, 16 h reaction, 2 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/drybox; Method A reduction under Ar after degassing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration to remove insolubles; concentration; layering with hexanes; standing at room temperature afforded purple-red crystals.
synthesis.yield: Method A: 1.8 g, 1.0 mmol, 26%; Method B: 1.5 g, 0.8 mmol, 20%

properties.summary: Mixed-valent Sm(II)/Sm(III) tetramer; room-temperature Gouy-balance effective magnetic moment μ_eff = 8.57 μB after diamagnetic correction.

measurements.name: μ_eff
measurements.conditions: room temperature, Gouy balance, diamagnetic correction applied
